bullish: Indicator: MTF Swing 30/50/200 + Pivot (v6). Map 4H→1D and 1D→1W. Read HTF data as CONFIRMED (closed HTF bar). Operating layer EMA 5/13/34; structural HTF SMA 30/50/200. Declare the exact MA type if the chart differs.

Panel long-compatible: Ctx LARGOS, Tr op ALC (EMA5>13>34 and close above 5/13/34), Tr HTF FUERTE or PULLBACK (SMA30>50>200 is FUERTE when close>SMA30; PULLBACK when SMA50<close≤SMA30). htfLongCompatible = SMA50>SMA200 and HTF close>SMA200 and HTF close>SMA50. Setup also needs chart close above HTF SMA 30, 50, and 200.

Indicator authorization (Conf ALC CONF) is the Pine longTrigger on a confirmed bar: break of a strength-3 pivot high (close > pivot high and prior close ≤ that high), RVOL ≥ 1.3× SMA20(volume), and EMA5/13 cross within the last 3 bars, with a confirmed pivot low for invalidation.

Framework TREND_CONTINUATION may exist with the stack and breakout already in place and Conf still PEND (no 5/13 cross inside 3 bars). Label it framework continuation, separate from ALC CONF. REACCELERATION is that same stack plus the recent 5/13 cross (what ALC CONF requires).

RECOVERY_ENTRY is framework reasoning only (the Pine does not emit it as longTrigger): HTF confirmed, not BAJ ESTR, support CONFIRMED, seller exhaustion CONFIRMED, Pivot Bias ALCISTA or RECUPERA_PIVOT, EMA5>EMA13 and close>EMA34, recent 5/13 cross, RVOL confirmed. Higher failure risk while Tr HTF is CORREC, DETER, or NEU.
Pivot Bias (P bias / P evt) is timing from the prior confirmed day H/L/C only. ALCISTA or RECUPERA_PIVOT is confluence. It does not authorize, set the stop, or set the target.
Still report daily and weekly SMA/WMA 20/50/200 on closed candles. Distance ≥20% above daily SMA200 is overextension (manage or wait); it does not change the fundamental score.
bearish: Shorts stay off by default. Bearish panel states are diagnostic: Tr HTF BAJ ESTR (SMA30<50<200 and close<SMA200) or DETER (close<SMA200 without the full bear stack), Tr op BAJ, Ctx EVITAR.
Conf BAJ DIAG is a confirmed breakdown of a pivot low with a recent 13/5 cross and volume. Use it to block new longs and to manage an existing long, not to open a short.
Pivot Bias BAJISTA or PIERDE_PIVOT is timing only.
neutral: Ctx ESPERAR or SIN ALIN: Tr HTF CORREC (SMA50>SMA200 and SMA200<close≤SMA50), DETER without a qualified recovery, NEU, or operating stack mixed. Setup WAIT or NO, Conf PEND.
Missing RVOL (≥1.3) when volume confirmation is on, or support BROKEN, keeps the name waiting.
Tunnel Domènec is an overlay. AllowedLongContext false is not a veto. Missing Tunnel data is an overlay pending, neither a pass nor a block when structural obstacles are checked another way.
Distribution, relief rally, or dead-cat context (good news sold, weak breadth): no new aggressive long bias.

risk_rules: Precedence: fundamental score and hard vetoes, then risk rules, then MTF entry, then Tunnel overlay, then market regime and sentiment caps.
New long only after fundamental score ≥70 with no hard veto. Discard <60; prioritize ≥80. Mark data pending when a key input is missing; do not fill it.

technical_entry.valid requires a qualified MTF setup, a structural stop, net R/R ≥2 after costs, a compatible context stack, effective_risk_scalar >0.25 on a single name, no blocking rotation/divergence, and no material obstacle before the economic target.

Max 10% of portfolio per position. Risk 1–2% per trade = (entry − stop) × shares. Apply effective_risk_scalar once to the cash risk budget, then cap shares by the 10% aggregate and liquidity. Cut size; do not tighten the stop to force the budget.
effective_risk_scalar = min(broad context cap, relative context cap). Caps combine by minimum. Scalar ≤0.25 pauses new single-name entries. Scalar ≤0.50 requires an A+ setup and liquidity.

Context stack GLOBAL → REGION → STYLE → SECTOR → INDUSTRY → INSTRUMENT. The weakest material layer limits new entries. Missing layer data is neutral 1.00 and is not favorable confirmation. A missing or stale weekly sentiment report: SENTIMIENTO_SEMANAL DATO PENDIENTE, sentiment_cap 1.00, effect NONE.
Orders: limit on pullbacks; stop orders only for a confirmed breakout or a protective exit.

Invalidation is by close (daily close for a daily swing). Thesis stop is the last confirmed pivot low. Protective reference = that level − ≥1.0×ATR(14). Panel Inv and Prot are diagnostic and do not replace the portfolio stop. If that distance implies more than 2% portfolio risk, cut size or skip.
Net R/R ≥2 after commissions and FX. A gross 2R target does not count until costs are in the numerator.
VIX sizing: ≤20 → 1×; 20–28 → 0.75×; >28 or VIX backwardation → pause unless A+ and ≤0.5× with wider stops.
Overextension: ≥20% above daily SMA200 → no aggressive new buy; manage or wait for a pullback. The 30/50/200 profile does not replace the 20/50/200 overextension check.
Tunnel overlay only: UpperObstacle_HT blocks or waits when it prevents net R/R ≥2; ExhaustionUp blocks an aggressive entry; ExhaustionDown and ribbons are confluence. Do not use Donchian.
Fridays: avoid late new entries unless the setup is A+.
At 1R take 25–40% and move the stop to break-even including costs; trail the remainder.
A blocked new entry is not a sell signal on an existing position.
notes: Profile: retail beginner; small tickets; base currency EUR; timezone Europe/Madrid. Technical source of truth on the chart: indicator MTF Swing 30/50/200 + Pivot, short title MTF Swing + Pivot. Defaults: auto HTF, confirmed HTF, EMA 5/13/34, SMA 30/50/200, pivot strength 3, cross window 3 bars, RVOL 1.3 on SMA20 volume, ATR(14), protective buffer ≥1.0 ATR, invalidation by close. Panel rows to read: TF, HTF, HTF data, Tr op, Tr HTF, Ctx, Setup, RVOL, Conf, Entry, Break, Inv, Prot, P bias, P evt. 30/50/200 is the swing implementation profile; still quote closed 20/50/200 for regime and the ≥20% SMA200 overextension check. Market-phase checklist: index vs SMA50/200; VIX level and contango/backwardation; breadth (% above SMA50/200, 90% up/down days); distribution vs accumulation; news reaction (panic absorbed vs good news sold). 2026 CIO map (as of 2026-06-29, context only): Bull ~25% / Base ~55% / Bear ~15% / Grizzly ~5%; Bull+Base ~80% constructive; monitor earnings, AI capex, inflation stickiness, unemployment >5%, credit spreads, USD risk-off. IPA (Quasimodo, QML, fakeouts, compression) is confluence, not an entry by itself. Trade plan: thesis, setup type and TF, HTF state, entry, daily-close stop, protective ATR reference, T1/T2, costs, net R/R, and ≥3 scenarios (base / acceleration / invalidation).
